entities.name: Charles César de Fay de La Tour-Maubourg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marie-Charles-César de Faÿ, comte de la Tour-Maubourg was a French soldier and politician during the French Revolution and the First French Empire. His father was Claude Florimond de Faÿ (1712–1790); his mother was Vacheron Bermont Marie Françoise.
